simple.meaning: נְהִי (nᵉhîy) is a Hebrew action word meaning “an elegy.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 7 times in Jeremiah, Amos, Micah, beginning at Jeremiah 9:9. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to נְהִי (H5092) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: נְהִי (nᵉhîy) / H5092 is traced through Jeremiah 9:9, Jeremiah 9:17, Jeremiah 9:18, Jeremiah 9:19 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.full: H5092. nehi נְהִי noun [masculine] wailing, lamentation, mourning song ; — ׳נ absolute Amos 5:16 5 t.; וָנֶהִ֑י Jer 9:9 ; — wailing, at ׳י s judgement Micah 2:4 as accusative of congnate meaning with verb; Jer 9:9 (c. עַלֿ נָשָׂא , + ׳בְּכִ , || קִינָה ), 9:17 (c, id.,|| דִּמְעָה ), 9:18 ( נ ׳קוֺל ), 31:15 (|| תַּמְרוּרִים בְּכִי, ); mourning song נ ׳יוֺדְעֵי Amos 5:16 of professional mourners, skilled in mourning song; compare Jer 9:19 , where taught (|| קִינָת ), also הִי Ezek 2:10 (|| אֵכֶל , מִסְמֵּד q. v. (Ol Co read נתי , compare Berthol).

occurrences.englishText: Shouldn’t I punish them for these things?” says Yahweh.
For a voice of wailing is heard out of Zion,
Therefore Yahweh, the God of Armies, the Lord, says:
In that day they will take up a parable against you,
